name: David Okonkwo
psychographics: Disciplined spender; believes in investing in quality that lasts rather than replacing cheap items frequently
current_solutions: Buys groceries from Mama Ade's bulk store; Uses Carbon credit app for airtime and data; Son watches cartoons on YouTube Kids
frustration: Received a ₦12,000 data bundle charge on the 14th of the month that failed to activate; spent 45 minutes on hold with customer service before the bundle expired unused
decision_style: Researches product specifications on forums for hours; will pay premium for durability but only if the warranty is iron-clad
voice: Calm and measured; uses technical terms like 'bandwidth' and 'latency' when describing app issues, but switches to Pidgin when frustrated
